body:
# HOSH Stats

HOSH Stats tracks player activity and provides a secure, short-lived web dashboard for server owners.

## Downloads

| | Modrinth |
|---|----------|
| **Hosh Loader** (required) | [Download Hosh Loader](https://modrinth.com/plugin/hosh-loader) |
| **HOSH Stats** (this plugin) | [Download HOSH Stats](https://modrinth.com/plugin/hosh-stats) |

## Requirements

- Paper 1.19.x / 1.20.x / 1.21.x
- Java 17+
- Hosh Loader (required)

## Commands

- `/stats <player>` - creates a short-lived secure dashboard link
- `/hosh stats reload` - reloads HOSH Stats via Hosh Loader

## Security

- Dashboard pages are short-lived and expire automatically
- Plugin communicates with your configured HOSH Stats web backend using a shared key
- Only users with `hoshstats.view` (default op) can create links

## Data tracked

- Core identity (UUID/name), first/last seen, total playtime
- Session and AFK timeline
- Chat history
- PvP/minigame values (kills, deaths, xp, level)
- Skin/cape history
- Moderation/ban history
- Up to 10 custom PlaceholderAPI values (`static` / `live`)
